core.jd_text: As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Parloa, you'll be on the front lines of enterprise AI adoption - delivering cutting-edge technology into some of the most complex environments in the world. Your mission: lead end-to-end deployment projects from an engineering perspective - not just implementing what exists, but engineering what's required to make it succeed at enterprise scale. FDEs are Parloa's in-field product engineers, building custom extensions, integrations, and configurations to close product gaps and meet enterprise requirements. Tech stack: Python, TypeScript, Node.js, OpenAI, Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, MCP. Requirements: 4+ years in software engineering/systems integration/DevOps/data engineering with direct customer impact; CS/Engineering degree; strong plus for AI/LLM systems experience (agent workflows, vector DBs, prompt orchestration). Salary Range: $140,000-$160,000 USD.

extension.hiring_manager_public_commentary: A Parloa PM (Natalie Telson) publicly recruited for the adjacent 'Forward Deployed Engineer, DevOps' req in Jan 2026, describing FDE work culture positively - this is a related but not identical req to the 'Forward Deployed Engineer - US' role assigned here.
extension.funding_or_layoff_signal: Mixed: Parloa raised a $350M Series D in Jan 2026 at a $3B valuation (total raised >$560M) and publicly stated plans to grow headcount from 380 to 600 by end of 2026, focused on developers and sales. Separately, a March 2026 Forbes op-ed headline references Parloa 'conducting its largest round of layoffs in years' in the same paragraph as a discussion of agentic AI efficiency gains - this claim is not corroborated by any dedicated layoff-tracking source found and may be a mis-attributed or contextual reference rather than a confirmed Parloa layoff event. Treat as unresolved.
extension.repost_pattern: Identical or near-identical JD text and title ('Forward Deployed Engineer - US' / 'Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - US') appears across at least 4 separate job-board listings and job IDs spanning 2025-08-18 through 2026-08-19, in addition to the LinkedIn listing evaluated here. This is consistent with either (a) a genuinely evergreen, continuously-open req class driven by real enterprise deployment demand, or (b) a rolling/recycled posting pattern. The role is still listed as open on Parloa's own Greenhouse board as of 2026-09-08 (3 days before this dossier), which favors (a) but does not fully resolve the ambiguity.

verdict.label: UNDECIDABLE
verdict.rationale: Strong ATTAINABLE signals: role is cross-listed on Parloa's own Greenhouse ATS (not aggregator-only), confirmed live 3 days before this dossier, salary band is transparent and internally consistent across 5+ independent mirrors, and the company just raised $350M at a $3B valuation with an explicit public commitment to grow engineering/field headcount from 380 to 600 by end of 2026 (evidence e1-e4, e6). Countervailing TRAP-adjacent signals: the identical JD/title has been reposted across at least 4 distinct job IDs over more than a year (evidence e5), which is a classic evergreen-or-recycled-req pattern, and one Forbes piece references Parloa layoffs in the same period without independent corroboration (evidence e7). Because the bullish funding/headcount-growth evidence and the bearish repost/layoff-ambiguity evidence directly conflict and neither fully falsifies the other, this does not cleanly resolve to ATTAINABLE or TRAP under the ternary gate - routing to human premortem per the winnability invariant.
